title: Subject Pronouns
subtitle: je, tu, il, elle, nous, vous, ils, elles. The distinction between tu and vous: singular familiar versus plural or formal.
objectives: Apply the concepts in reading and writing.

sections.heading: Main content
sections.body: Subject pronouns in French mark person, number, and in the third person, gender. The tu/vous distinction is crucial: tu is singular and familiar (friends, family, children); vous is plural or formal (strangers, superiors, groups).

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you can apply the concepts without hesitation.
